name: Not of This World
oracle_text:
Counter target spell or ability that targets a permanent you control.
This spell costs {7} less to cast if it targets a spell or ability that targets a creature you control with power 7 or greater.
blocked_sentences: This spell costs {7} less to cast if it targets a spell or ability that targets a creature you control with power 7 or greater.

needs.what: a cost_reduction 'targeting' gate that can look through a stack-object target to its targets: {amount: 7} if the chosen spell-or-ability target itself targets a creature you control with power 7 or greater
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cost_reduction 'targeting' filters the cast's object targets with cost_reduction_filter_keys (types, controller, power...) but a stack-object target has no such characteristics and there is no key to reach the objects that stack object targets; the first sentence is expressible with the `that_targets` selector key on the spell_or_ability target
